scenario: Same corporation; punctuation/suffix variation in name; same authoritative state entity and USDOT
decision_rule: Authoritative entity continuity controls over string variation

scenario: Same corporation changes legal name; state entity survives; USDOT unchanged
decision_rule: Name change does not create a new person when entity survives

scenario: Corporation changes owner through stock sale; corporation survives
decision_rule: Owner is not the corporation

scenario: Corporation changes officers and address; same state entity and USDOT
decision_rule: Demographic change does not create new corporate person

scenario: Sole proprietor sells business/assets to unrelated buyer
decision_rule: Natural-person USDOT cannot transfer to buyer

scenario: Sole proprietor changes form to corporation under FMCSA published continuity exception; operations/officials/assets identical
decision_rule: Legal person and FMCSA registrant continuity can diverge

scenario: Two active LLC carriers share same individual owner
decision_rule: Common ownership is relationship, not identity

scenario: Two active corporations share parent company but have different registrations
decision_rule: Subsidiaries remain distinct legal persons

scenario: Parent corporation and wholly owned subsidiary
decision_rule: 100% ownership does not create identity equivalence

scenario: Two carriers at same registered-agent office with no other links
decision_rule: Address is weak relational evidence

scenario: Two owner-operators use same residential address but are separate state persons/registrants
decision_rule: Residential/shared household address cannot force merge

scenario: Father and adult child own separate carriers at same address
decision_rule: Family relationship is separately disclosed relation

scenario: Two unrelated carriers use same outsourced dispatch phone number
decision_rule: Shared contact service does not prove identity

scenario: Two carriers use same insurer
decision_rule: Common insurer is non-dispositive

scenario: Vehicle sold from Carrier A to Carrier B; VIN appears under both at different times
decision_rule: Legitimate asset purchase is known false-link mechanism

scenario: Owner-operator leases tractor to Carrier B while retaining separate business
decision_rule: Equipment use is not legal-person identity

scenario: Carrier A acquires Carrier B's stock; B survives as corporation
decision_rule: Acquisition can preserve target entity

scenario: Carrier A and B merge into newly formed Carrier C; A/B dissolve
relationship_expected: A PREDECESSOR_OF C; B PREDECESSOR_OF C
decision_rule: New legal person/new USDOT possible after merger

scenario: New Carrier C receives transferred operating authority from predecessor after merger
decision_rule: OA transfer does not imply same person

scenario: Carrier A buys all assets of B but no corporate stock/entity
decision_rule: Asset continuity is not person identity

scenario: Observation claims USDOT assigned by FMCSA to another legal person
decision_rule: Claimed identifier is not authoritative assignment

scenario: Commercial tender has one-digit USDOT typo; other authoritative evidence identifies sender
decision_rule: Do not let typo alone split/merge; preserve claim

scenario: Observation missing USDOT but official state ID + historical FMCSA evidence establish same corporation
decision_rule: Task A can resolve without visible USDOT

scenario: Two records share USDOT because one is a duplicate extract of same FMCSA record
decision_rule: Duplicate observations cluster to same person

scenario: Two observations share USDOT but official FMCSA correction shows one historic record was erroneous
decision_rule: Preserve erroneous observation and correction chronology

scenario: Different corporations with confusingly identical legal names in different states
decision_rule: Name coincidence is documented false-link mechanism

scenario: Same corporation uses DBA different from legal name
decision_rule: DBA is alias/name, not separate person

scenario: Two different legal persons use similar DBAs
decision_rule: Trade-name similarity is non-dispositive

scenario: State record says entity dissolved; later FMCSA extract still says registration active
decision_rule: State legal status and federal registration status are different predicates

scenario: State corporation active; FMCSA registration inactive
decision_rule: Legal existence is not FMCSA operating status

scenario: Two distinct carriers share manager and customers but operate simultaneously
decision_rule: Several continuity factors can exist among separate firms

scenario: New company created immediately after old carrier ceases; owners/managers/equipment/insurance/facility/customers overlap
decision_rule: Continuity can be strong while legal persons remain distinct

scenario: Same as EC-032 but no adverse history/motive evidence
decision_rule: Legitimate business purpose cannot be inferred away

scenario: Same as EC-032 with severe prior adverse history but no authoritative order
decision_rule: Bad history does not change Task A identity label

scenario: Final FMCSA §386.73 order determines reincarnation between two distinct entities
decision_rule: Regulatory finding does not collapse legal persons

scenario: FMCSA §386.73 order served but timely review petition stays it
decision_rule: Procedural status must be preserved

scenario: Final FMCSA order later rescinded after corrective action
decision_rule: Later rescission changes disposition status, not historical observations

scenario: FMCSA consolidates records of current and affiliated entities
decision_rule: Agency record consolidation is not entity merge

scenario: Common owner + same address + same insurer, but separately incorporated and simultaneous independent operations
decision_rule: Preamble warns separate fleets can share many factors

scenario: Only vendor aggregator says two firms are same; official sources unavailable
decision_rule: Non-authoritative candidate evidence cannot force label

scenario: Two competent state records conflict on same legal status/date and no correction is available
decision_rule: Genuine authoritative conflict remains unresolved

scenario: Later merger filing proves relation, but model feature cutoff predates filing
decision_rule: Retrospective adjudication cannot leak future features

scenario: Model receives final FMCSA reincarnation order that occurred after prediction date
decision_rule: Post-cutoff order is prohibited input

scenario: Carrier has both carrier and broker roles under same legal person with separate registrations
decision_rule: Roles/registrations do not create extra persons

scenario: Carrier LLC and broker LLC share owner but are separately formed
decision_rule: Separate persons despite functional complementarity

scenario: Individual John Doe d/b/a Doe Trucking compared to trade name Doe Trucking
decision_rule: DBA maps to natural person sole proprietor

scenario: Individual owner John Doe compared to John Doe Inc.
decision_rule: Natural person and corporation are separate legal persons

scenario: Same SCAC Verified status appears across renewal events for a carrier
decision_rule: SCAC verification is trade-credential evidence, not legal-person ground truth

scenario: Verified human completes SCAC process for company account
decision_rule: Human identity proofing is distinct from organizational identity

scenario: One Motus user accesses two company accounts
decision_rule: One human can act for multiple organizations

scenario: Two company accounts accidentally created for same corporation, both linked to same authoritative legal person
decision_rule: Digital account identity is not legal-person identity

scenario: Different legal persons share a commercial parent LEI relationship
decision_rule: External identity system also separates who-is-who/ownership

scenario: Two records disagree only because one source is stale old address
decision_rule: Stale evidence remains historically valid but not current

scenario: Two records have no decisive IDs; names/address/phone all similar; no authoritative corporate source retrieved
decision_rule: Ambiguous case must abstain

scenario: Two records have many agreeing fields but authoritative state records prove separate simultaneous corporations
decision_rule: Authoritative legal distinctness defeats fuzzy similarity

scenario: One record has bad safety history and another clean record has weak name/address overlap only
regulatory_disposition_expected: motive may create review candidate only
decision_rule: Adverse history cannot supply missing identity evidence

scenario: Candidate-generation model score is shown to adjudicator before label
decision_rule: Gold labels must be blinded from tested model/candidate score

scenario: Two primary reviewers disagree and third reviewer also says evidence insufficient
decision_rule: Third reviewer need not force match/nonmatch

scenario: Pair labels imply A=B and B=C but A≠C for same time/version
decision_rule: Same-legal-person must be transitive; cluster must be repaired

scenario: Benchmark gold label built from USDOT assignment and tested model sees that exact authoritative USDOT field
decision_rule: Result is identifier lookup, not headline ER evidence; use masked/corrupted regimes

scenario: Two legally distinct carriers operate simultaneously under common ownership/control and share several operational factors
decision_rule: Simultaneous related operation can support affiliation; common control does not create legal-person equality

scenario: Later one of the EC-061 carriers ceases and the other continues substantially the same operation; no final agency order exists
decision_rule: Relationship state is time-indexed; analytical continuity is not final regulatory reincarnation

scenario: Final FMCSA §386.73 order after contested review finds one distinct carrier reincarnated as another
decision_rule: Final order is authoritative disposition about distinct entities; it does not merge their legal-person nodes

scenario: Texas Comptroller shows forfeited or no right to transact while Secretary-of-State filing history still identifies the same corporation
task_a_expected: SAME_LEGAL_PERSON if official entity ID/history matches
decision_rule: Comptroller right-to-transact status and SOS corporate-file identity are different predicates

scenario: Two Louisiana entities have confusingly similar names but different official charter/entity numbers
relationship_expected: UNKNOWN unless separate evidence supports relation
decision_rule: Official jurisdiction-qualified entity identifiers defeat name-only similarity

scenario: Official state source cannot yet be retrieved because access requires CAPTCHA, paid portal, or manual document order; vendor aggregator claims a match
task_a_expected: UNRESOLVED unless other competent authoritative evidence suffices
decision_rule: Do not silently substitute a lower-authority aggregator when the competent state source is unavailable

scenario: Texas SOS filing history establishes a corporate transaction while a third-party profile still shows stale pre-transaction name/status
decision_rule: Predicate-competent official transaction filing controls over stale vendor profile; preserve old observation historically

scenario: A final agency reincarnation order is later stayed, rescinded, or reversed by a controlling later disposition
decision_rule: Disposition history is append-only and status-bearing; later controlling process changes current regulatory conclusion without rewriting entity identity

scenario: Gold legal-person cluster was built from an official state entity ID and the tested model receives that exact canonical state entity ID
decision_rule: Exact state identity anchor creates the same tautology risk as exact authoritative USDOT; headline ER requires masked/missing/corrupted regimes

scenario: One legal corporation uses several DBAs/brands and maintains branch addresses; official state entity ID and FMCSA assignment tie observations to one person
decision_rule: Trade names and locations are observations/attributes of the same person when authoritative identity evidence establishes continuity
